data.short_description: A recently approved ABC Inspection Zoning Permit filed under the name "Abyssinia" indicates potential changes at the address currently occupied by Queen Sheba Ethiopian Restaurant & Bar. The introduction of a new business name suggests a possible rebranding, new concept, or operational change. No formal announcement has been made and the restaurant continues to operate.

data.status: targeting an October or November opening, pending permit approvals
data.short_description: La Victoria Cocina Mexicana is preparing to expand into Raleigh, marking its second location after Cary. It is currently targeting an October or November opening, pending permit approvals. The concept serves authentic Mexican and Tex-Mex dishes including carnitas, chilaquiles, and al pastor tacos, with a dedicated kids' menu.

data.status: in the design and planning stages
data.short_description: Atomic Wings is planning its first Ohio location near the Ohio State University campus at University Gateway North. The franchise owner confirmed a target opening before the college football season, though the project is still in design and planning. The Buffalo-inspired chain will serve fresh, never-frozen halal chicken wings, tenders, sandwiches, and flavored dirty sodas.

data.status: aiming for a July opening date
data.short_description: A liquor license application was submitted for Osteria Gilberto, a new Italian concept coming to Lincoln Park's corner of Webster and Magnolia. Owner Sergio Barbone, who also operates Bakehouse Chicago, declined to share further details at this time. Social media pages will be created closer to opening to share menu and construction updates.

Le Petit Comptoir Wine & Cheese is preparing to open beside Marblehead House of Pizza, offering small plates, charcuterie, grilled cheeses, and wine in a welcoming, all-ages atmosphere. Owner Alex Lewis is currently hiring and has been building buzz through pre-opening wine-and-cheese tasting events and pairing classes. The timeline remains dependent on final preparations and hiring efforts.

The Laureate is a new boutique hotel planned for downtown Aiken, incorporating the historic Farmers and Merchants Bank Building at 167 Laurens St. along with adjacent property. The development will include 84 hotel rooms and suites, a lobby bar, garden courtyard, and a restaurant and bar within the historic bank space whose name and menu are still being finalized. Groundbreaking is set for fall 2026.
